body:
Add the core 3-axis Brother Speedio post (`assets/posts/brother-speedio.cps`) targeting Brother CNC-C00 and CNC-D00 NC language.

## Scope
- Declare manifest capabilities (`coolantModes`, `afterModes`, `axisInversion`, `probeAxisInversion`, `millSpindleReverse`, `programUnits = "mm inch"`, `explains`).
- Emit `%`, 4-digit `O` program numbers (`O0001`–`O9999`) with optional comment, explicit `G20` or `G21` from document units, and safety block `G90 G17 G40 G49 G80`.
- Implement Brother `G100 T.. X.. Y..` followed by `G43 H.. Z.. S.. M03/M04` as default tool change, plus a post property fallback for `G91 G28 Z0` + `T.. M06`.
- Omit Fanuc standby next-tool `T` calls, extra M-codes on `G100`/`M06` blocks, and unconfigured rotary axes on `G100`.
- Emit `G77` (right-hand) and `G78` (left-hand) rigid tapping with pitch `I` (`FeedRate / SpindleSpeed`), optional `Q` peck, optional `L` return RPM, and no `F` word. Support `G73`, `G81`, `G82`, `G83`, `G85`, `G86`, and `G89` cycles, plus incremental `I`/`J`/`K` `G2`/`G3` helical arcs with `G17`/`G18`/`G19`.
- Resolve `M08`/`M09`, `M458`/`M459`, and `M494`/`M495` from `machine.coolants`, refuse unsupported coolant kinds and spindle-stopped or missing-feed moves, and emit zero coolant on probe sections.

Done means: `assets/posts/brother-speedio.cps` is registered in `BUILTINS` (`crates/app/src/posting.rs`), posts all 13 `GOLDENS` in `crates/app/tests/conformance.rs` under `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/brother-speedio/`, and passes `crates/post/tests/script_brother_speedio.rs` and `crates/post/tests/brother_speedio_post.rs`.

Part of #1960
